set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set access radius-server [parameter1].explanation: Configures a RADIUS server with specified parameters (e.g., IP, port, secret) for authentication, authorization, and accounting in Junos OS.

secret [parameter2].explanation: The command `secret [parameter2]` in Junos configures a secret key or password, where `[parameter2]` specifies the actual secret value to be used.

port [parameter2].explanation: The command `port [parameter2]` in Junos specifies the port number or interface for a specific configuration, such as setting a port for a service or protocol.

accounting-port [parameter2].explanation: The `accounting-port` command specifies the UDP port number for RADIUS accounting packets, where `[parameter2]` is the port number to be used.

set access profile [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment sets an access profile in Junos, defining a named profile (parameter1) to configure security policies, authentication, or authorization settings for network access.

parameters.name: profile-name
parameters.explanation: Accesses the name of the profile.

authentication-order [parameter2].explanation: Configures the authentication order for access to the profile.

accounting-order [parameter2].explanation: Configures the billing order of the default access profile.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

encapsulation [parameter3].explanation: Configure the envelope type of the interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set services l2tp access-concentrator [p.explanation: The command configures an L2TP Access Concentrator (LAC) with the specified parameter1, defining its role in the L2TP network for tunneling PPP sessions.

parameters.name: access-concentrator
parameters.explanation: L2TP access to the centralizer name.

tunnel password [parameter2].explanation: The command `tunnel password [parameter2]` sets a shared secret password for GRE or IP-IP tunnels, ensuring secure communication between tunnel endpoints.

tunnel source [parameter2].explanation: The command `tunnel source [parameter2]` specifies the source IP address or interface for the tunnel, where `[parameter2]` is the IP address or interface name.

tunnel load-sharing.explanation: The `tunnel load-sharing` command in Junos enables or configures load balancing across multiple tunnels for optimized traffic distribution and resource utilization.

virtual-template [parameter2].explanation: The command `virtual-template [parameter2]` in Junos creates a virtual interface template, where `[parameter2]` specifies the template number for dynamic interface configuration.

parameters.name: virtual-template
parameters.explanation: The number of the virtual template.

set routing-options static route [parame.explanation: This command configures a static route in Junos, where `[parameter1]` is the destination network and `[parameter2]` is the subnet mask.
